effects: Sets or resets the application-level opt out flag. If set, no hits will be sent to Google Analytics.
Application-level opt out is enforced. No hits will be sent to Google Analytics.
Application-level opt out is not enforced. Hits can be sent to Google Analytics.

conditions: On devices running API level 14 (ICE_CREAM_SANDWICH) or above
effects: Enables automatic reporting of activity start and stop, eliminating the need for manual reporting.
Returns whether the state of the application-level opt out is on.

conditions: Only works when Google Play services is not available and local dispatching is used.
effects: Dispatches hits queued in the application store to Google Analytics, if a network connection is available.

conditions: Only works if local dispatching is in use. Local dispatching is used in absence of Google Play services.
effects: Sets dispatch period for the local dispatcher. If zero or negative, automatic dispatch will be disabled.
Automatic dispatch is disabled; dispatcher will not check for hits to dispatch.
